hypothesis: The v3 numerical collapse is caused by feeding an interleaved block_q8_Kx4 activation buffer to a row-major block_q8_K GEMV. Quantizing only exact-four-row Q4_K 8x8 operations as four ordinary row-major Q8_K rows should restore exact outputs while retaining the v3 shared-weight-decode speedup.

implementation.base: Pinned llama.cpp plus cache-order v1, promoted fused one-to-three-row v2, and rejected exact-four-row v3
implementation.single_independent_change: For Q4_K 8x8 operations with ne11 == 4, bypass ggml_quantize_mat_t and call the ordinary Q8_K from_float converter independently for each row.
unchanged: all activation packing for row counts other than four

stop_rules: Stop before graph timing if backend or ordinary-decode parity fails.
Stop before the four-prompt MTP3 run if the first MTP3 prompt changes any committed token or draft acceptance count.
Reject if the real-model four-row graph speedup is below 1.10.
Reject if terminal MTP3 throughput improves by less than five percent.
Do not interpret a faster graph with invalid logits as a performance result.
claim_boundary: A pass promotes one layout-coherent exact-four-row AVX2 verification kernel on four Milan cores. The trained approximation, broad quality, final-node, energy, 100 accepted tok/s, and novelty gates remain open.
